title: Campaign runs counted, review findings as judge lessons, an advice answer to judge, and the primary metric kept by the rule
request: The owner: fix the campaign runs the store did not collect, the advice track with no product, the missing m7 judges review findings set, and the team gate's churn metric check.
spec: Campaign runs counted from what the store keeps; every reviewer finding a judged claim with its verdict; Home answers an advice request from the Evidence library and a thumb on any result reply is the track's outcome; the primary metric follows the person's word or the positive rate.
plan: Find why the store sees no campaign run
Build the review findings set and record declined findings from now on
Give the advice track an answer, and make thumbs on result replies reach the outcome
Find why the team scores the churn replica by average precision
Tests, live team gate, record, commit

decisions.decision: Campaign runs are counted from their trace rows, not by installing numpy in the agent environment
decisions.why: the session log needs dclab_core's contracts, which need numpy; the trace rows (agent_steps.jsonl) already reach the store, one run per run id

decisions.decision: Review findings are a set of their own at lower weight, and a finding gets a verdict field
decisions.why: they judge DCLab's own code, not ML work; 2,624 confirmed claims against one declined one cannot teach a judge that a plausible claim can be false, so declined findings are recorded from now on

decisions.decision: The advice answer comes from the Evidence library's search and its citation check, the closest records when no model answers
decisions.why: the same checked path as the Evidence page: no number or claim reaches the person that a record does not hold

decisions.decision: The planner may report another metric beside the primary one, never in its place
decisions.why: the rule chooses ROC-AUC when positives are not rare; the planner's preference for average precision on a balanced outcome broke the replica's acceptance

change: dclab_rnd.store.coverage counts trace-only agents' runs (campaign); dclab_rnd.agentic main installs a session log. dclab_rnd.devlog Finding.verdict, declined findings kept out of fix examples; dclab_rnd.store.sets.others review_findings into m7_judges/review_findings. dclab_rnd.draft.chat advise (Evidence library answer, the person's latest words); Home's page shows an advice answer's sources; the feedback route's thumb refuses a reply of an earlier track (track_messages_from); evidence.ask and capture.evidence_search join the search to its draft. dclab-core 0.146.0: plan's guard refuses an advisor's change of the primary metric. Also: experience.file_workspace_id names its marker without storage.db.

findings.defect: The store recorded no campaign run
findings.scenario: Four campaign runs today left trace rows but no run.recorded event
findings.cause: the command line installed no session log, and in the agent environment the session log records nothing (no numpy, no core contracts)
findings.fix: the coverage counts a trace-only agent's runs from its trace rows

findings.defect: The reviewer's findings taught no model
findings.scenario: 2,624 reviewer findings sat in the development records with their tests, outside every set
findings.fix: m7_judges/review_findings: each finding a judged claim, by its test or the developer's verdict

findings.defect: The advice track produced nothing to judge
findings.scenario: An advice request got a sentence pointing to the Evidence library and no answer
findings.cause: Home's advice track had no exit of its own
findings.fix: Home answers from the Evidence library with its sources, recorded as a produced answer

findings.defect: The team scored a balanced churn outcome by average precision
findings.scenario: TEAM-001 and TEAM-002: the solution planner made average precision primary on the churn replica, and its acceptance check failed
findings.cause: the plan's guard let an advisor replace the primary metric the rules set
findings.fix: the guard refuses it; another metric goes beside the primary one

findings.defect: The browser coverage test did not know the understand check
findings.scenario: test_web_client failed: the browser script gained the understanding conversation's check on 29 Oct
findings.cause: the expected list was not updated with the check
findings.fix: understand added to the expected checks

findings.defect: A new thumb route counted every thumb twice
findings.scenario: One click on a result reply appended thumb_up twice: the feedback route already turned a thumb into the track's action (_thumb_outcome)
findings.cause: I took the gap for a missing path and did not look for the existing one in pages/ledger.py
findings.fix: the new route, method and page call removed; the existing path kept

findings.defect: A campaign run was counted twice
findings.scenario: A run.recorded names its trace's run id as its parent; the trace rows counted the same run again
findings.cause: the trace count compared trace ids with the session records' own new ids
findings.fix: trace ids named by a session record's parent or run id are skipped

findings.defect: The metric guard let an advisor replace the person's named metric
findings.scenario: A brief naming average precision on a balanced table: the planner's roc_auc passed the guard
findings.cause: the guard skipped its check when the brief named the metric
findings.fix: every advisor change of the primary metric is refused, the person's word named as its setter

findings.defect: A thumb on an earlier track's result judged the current track
findings.scenario: An analysis answer, then advice and its answer; a thumb down on the old answer refused the advice outcome
findings.cause: the thumb path read any product reply of the draft
findings.fix: a track switch records its first message; the thumb path refuses replies before it

findings.defect: The advice answer searched the start of everything said
findings.scenario: A long first request then a new question on the advice track: the search read only the old text
findings.cause: the question was all the person's words joined and cut at 800 characters

findings.defect: Review findings: wrong judges, repeated ids and a split that leaked
findings.scenario: 133 findings whose test field named no test counted as test-proven; two ids appeared twice; 371 sealed rows came from packages the development set trains on
findings.cause: a loose test check, ids taken as written, and a split of its own
findings.fix: proof only by a named test, a reused id made unique, the development set's train packages kept in train

findings.defect: A data-limit test lost its dispute
findings.scenario: The debate test disputed the primary metric; the new guard refused the change, so the judge was never asked and its data limit never checked
findings.cause: the test relied on an advisor replacing the primary metric
findings.fix: the test disputes the threshold policy

measurements.name: review findings set
measurements.gate: every reviewer finding judged, a package in one split
measurements.result: 2,625 judged findings: 2,071 proven by a named test, 553 confirmed by the developer, 1 declined; sealed rows only from packages the development set never trains on
limits: only one declined finding: the set cannot yet teach that a plausible claim can be false

measurements.name: team gate, live
measurements.gate: team_gate_v1 on the fraud, churn and delivery replicas with every role on
measurements.result: TEAM-003 passes, every replica's acceptance checks right; EUR 0.23

outcome: Campaign runs counted, review findings in m7 judges with declined findings recorded from now on, an advice answer that a thumb judges, thumbs counted on every result reply, and the primary metric kept by the rule.
lessons: A missing count can be a missing reader: look at what the store already keeps
A set of only confirmed claims cannot teach a judge to doubt: record the declined ones
A button that exists but goes nowhere is a gap no test of the button finds
risks: The advice answer leans on the evidence index's coverage: questions outside it get the closest records or a plain no
A brief whose metric was inferred rather than said would still let its metric lead
